verdict.rationale: Missive has an in-product AI Assistant/Copilot. It can compose, reply to and translate messages, create drafts, and run visible long sessions. It can also be connected through custom MCP to internal systems and proprietary data. However, it runs on your own Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini API key. The clearest data-insight examples (summarizing the inbox, CRM triage) are framed as external apps like Claude acting through MCP, not as built-in insights. Missing for 10: documented in-product insights such as summaries, trends or proactive suggestions drawn from the user's own data; AI that works without bringing your own key; independent or hands-on corroboration.
